## Publishing R package with asreml dependency

Since `asreml` is a propreity software, you cannot just import `asreml` in an R package that depends on it. 

In the DESCRIPTION file, you ought to add that 

```bash
SystemRequirements:
    asreml (>= 4.2.0)
```

Some R packages on CRAN that has an asreml R dependency:

```{r setup}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
db <- tools::CRAN_package_db() |> 
    tibble::tibble()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: asis
db |> 
    filter(str_detect(tolower(Description), "asreml")) |> 
    select(Package) |> 
    mutate(Package = str_glue("[{Package}](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/{Package}/index.html)")) |> 
    str_glue_data("- {Package}")
```
